- Confirm build vendor and staging window by EOD Thursday (Aaron Brooks from StandBuild has availability).

- Confirm crate counts and max crate dimensions so logistics can reserve ground handling.

I've looped Rishi for PO/finance intake and Stephanie for booth ops. If all agree, I'll put Aaron on a short call with Marissa and the organizer to confirm sightlines and height limits.

Hi Mina —

Congrats on securing the 20x20 island. A few rules and reminders from the show office:

- Island booth max build height is 8 ft for any structure within 10 ft of aisles; up to 12 ft allowed in the center of island if drawings are approved.
- All materials must meet fire-code; please include material specs with any custom builds.
- Freight staging window is Tue–Thu the week before the show (5/17–5/19) with preferred delivery to Moscone East receiving dock.
- Power/truss/AV orders go through the exhibitor portal: https://exhibitor.techsummit.org/portal/space/RSW-479 (use company account to place orders).

I attached the exhibitor rules summary (exhibitor_rules.pdf) — please circulate to your build vendor and sign the exhibitor waiver in the portal once you confirm the final floorplans.

If you want, I can approve a 12 ft center element once I see the final elevation drawings.

Best,
Elena Morales
Exhibitor Services Manager
TechSummit Events
elena@techsummit.org

---
Attachment: exhibitor_rules.pdf

From: Aaron Brooks <aaron@standbuild.co>

Cc: Sam Li <sam@pacificfreight.com>
Date: 2027-05-13T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Booth space selection + shipping/build ops for TechSummit — StandBuild notes and quote

Hi Mina / Marissa —

Thanks for the heads up. Reviewed the initial siteplan and TechSummit rules — a few practical points from the build side: 

1) Recommended footprint and sightlines: keep tall elements centered and submit a front elevation for the 12 ft approval. We can do a partial 12 ft header over the demo zone; the perimeter should remain 8 ft.
2) Crate counts & sizes: expect 3 crates (approx 62"x48"x54") and 1 pallet for counters/AV. If you want separate demo crates, add +1 crate.
3) Build timeline: load-in day is 5/18 (preferred). We need materials onsite by 10 AM. Build time ~6–8 hours with our 2-person crew.
4) Signage: recommend vinyl on 3/8" sintra for backwall + two acrylic 24"x36" demo panels. Order lead time is 6–8 business days.
5) Quote & specs attached — build_quote_20270513.pdf and crate_specs.xlsx. Lead time on custom metal shelving (gatefold shelving idea) is 12 business days.

Estimated build & materials total (excluding drayage/power): $6,450. If you confirm signage/fonts and shipping window by 5/20 we can lock in the May build slot.

PO / billing: Please send PO to billing@standbuild.co or sign the DocuSign envelope I can initiate once we have scope.

Thanks —
Aaron Brooks
Project Manager, StandBuild Co.
aaron@standbuild.co
(206) 555-0199

Attachments: build_quote_20270513.pdf, crate_specs.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2027-05-13T11:05:00-07:00

Mina / Aaron —

I'm good with the gatefold shelving and the 12 ft center element pending Elena's sign-off on the elevation. A few quick confirmations from my side: 

- Backwall graphics: full-bleed 8' H x 20' W (send final art dims).
- Header sign: keep to 10' wide max if we go 12' center height.
- Counters: 2 demo counters (36" x 24") + 1 locked storage cabinet for laptops.
- Swag: 800 units — will confirm actual items by Thursday.

Rishi — can you start a PO for StandBuild for the $6,450 estimate so we can get them to initiate the DocuSign? If the final comes in higher we'll route a change order.

I'll prepare the artwork spec sheet and drop into the Drive link Mina shared.

Marissa
